params.name: Preset
params.description: Size of the page. Letter, A4, Legal and Tabloid are paper sizes; HD, 4K and Square are fixed pixel sizes; Custom uses Width and Height.

params.name: Units
params.description: Unit that Width and Height, and every length on the nodes drawing onto this page, are written in. Pixels are converted to inches by Resolution.

params.name: Width
params.description: Page width for the Custom preset, in Units. In Pixels it is the image's pixel width; its physical size then depends on Resolution.

params.name: Height
params.description: Page height for the Custom preset, in Units. In Pixels it is the image's pixel height; its physical size then depends on Resolution.

params.name: Orientation
params.description: Portrait keeps the paper size upright; Landscape swaps its width and height. Only paper presets can be turned.

params.name: Resolution
params.description: Pixels per inch (DPI). More pixels for a paper size; for pixel presets it sets the physical size. Stored in exported PNGs so prints come out at size.

params.name: Color
params.description: Background colour the whole page is filled with before anything is drawn on it.

params.name: Opacity
params.description: Opacity of the background fill, 0 to 1. At 0 the page is clear and only what is drawn on it shows; clear areas are see-through in the viewport and PNG.

params.name: Position
params.description: Where the centre of the page stands in the 3D scene, in world units. The page lies in the XY plane facing +Z at its physical size.
